check: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q && ! grep -nE "^_registry|^[[:space:]]*global " plugins.py app.py extras.py cli.py
prompt: plugins.py keeps its registry in module-level state, which makes the code impossible to test in isolation. Make `plugins.Registry` a class with `register(name, fn)`, `get(name)` and `names()` (sorted), remove the module-level state, and pass a registry explicitly: `app.build(registry)`, `app.run(registry, name, text)`, `extras.install(registry)` and `cli.available(registry)`. Update every caller. Do not change the tests.
title: Replace a module-level registry with one the caller owns
